answer: Each epoch a random beacon picks five established peers in different regions to time a round-trip to every earning identity. Personas run on one box return the same latency fingerprint, hanging like grapes on one vine, and identities whose fingerprints match for three epochs share a single reward. To forge distinct fingerprints a farm needs a separate host in a separate network location per persona, roughly $5 a month each, so 1,000 fakes cost $5,000 monthly while an honest agent pays nothing extra.
